question: The Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB) is a statutory multi-disciplinary body under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC). Its headquarters is in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wildlife Crime Control Bureau **is a **statutory body**.
 
• It was **established **by the **Government of India **under the **Ministry of Environment, Forest **and **Climate Change**.
 
• Its **motive **is to **combat organized wildlife crime**.
 
• The **Wild Life Amendment Act, 2006 **provisions **came in to force on 6th June 2007**.
 
• It **became operational in the year 2008**.
 
• Its **headquarter **is **at rikoot-1 Building, 2nd Floor, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi-110066.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhupendra Yadav**, Ministry of Environment, **Forest and Climate Change is the responsible minister **of WCCB.
 
• **Tilotama Varma **is the **Agency executive **of **WCCB**.
 
• **Seva kurma**:
 
 
• It l**aunched WCCB.**
 
• Its **duration **was from to **15th December 2016 **to **30th January 2017**.
 
• The **motive **is **to focus **on the **poaching**, **transportation**, and **illegal trade **of **live turtles and tortoises**.
 
• The **operation resulted **in **the seizure of more than 15,912 **live **turtles **and the **arrest of 55 suspects**.
